(the “Company”) obtained the consent of the requisite lenders under its revolving credit facility, dated May 12, 2023, with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent, to, among other things, amend certain provisions by entering into the Third Amendment to Credit Agreement, dated as of September 30, 2026 (the “Third Amendment to Credit Agreement”). On October 8, 2026, the Company entered into the following agreements (collectively, the “Note Purchase Agreement Amendments”): a. Note Purchase Agreement Amendment No. 5, dated as of September 30, 2026, by and among the Company and the noteholders party thereto with respect to the Note Purchase Agreement, dated as of December 11, 2015, by and among the Company and the other parties thereto; b. Note Purchase and Guarantee Agreement Amendment No. 5, dated as of September 30, 2026, by and among the Company, DENTSPLY DENTAL B.V. (as successor by merger to Sirona Dental Services GmbH) and the noteholders party thereto with respect to the Note Purchase and Guarantee Agreement, dated as of October 27, 2016, by and among the Company, Sirona Dental Services GmbH and the other parties thereto; and c. Note Purchase Agreement Amendment No. 5, dated as of September 30, 2026, by and among the Company and the noteholders party thereto with respect to the Note Purchase Agreement, dated as of June 24, 2019, by and among the Company and the other parties thereto. Pursuant to (a) the Note Purchase Agreement Amendments, the Company and the applicable noteholders have agreed, among other things, and (b) the Third Amendment to Credit Agreement, the Company, the lenders party thereto and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. have agreed, among other things, to: (i) increase the maximum permitted Total Leverage Ratio and the maximum permitted Senior Leverage Ratio, in each case for the fiscal quarters ending September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2026; (ii) permit an additional addback to EBITDA for certain cash charges or expenses incurred during the fiscal quarters ending September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2026; (iii) until the delivery of a compliance certificate with respect to the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026, (A) generally prohibit new liens and new subsidiary debt, other than those existing before September 30, 2026, the effective date of the Note Purchase Agreement Amendments and the Third Amendment to Credit Agreement, and (B) limit restricted payments, with certain carveouts; and (iv) during a specified period, add quarterly reporting requirements on certain initiatives and the related costs and savings, among other disclosures. In addition, (a) the Third Amendment to Credit Agreement adds a new pricing level for the applicable margin and facility fee and (b) the Note Purchase Agreement Amendments increase the incremental interest payable on the notes if the Company’s total leverage ratio equals or exceeds specified thresholds. The revised terms contained in the amendments described herein are intended to allow the Company to maintain compliance with its debt covenants in all material respects. Copies of the Third Amendment to Credit Agreement and the Note Purchase Agreement Amendments are attached hereto as Exhibits 4.1, 4.2, 4.3 and 4.4, respectively, to this Current Report on Form 8-K and are incorporated herein by reference. The above description of the material terms of each of the Third Amendment to Credit Agreement and the Note Purchase Agreement Amendments does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to such Exhibits. Item 2.03 Creation of a Direct Financial Obligation or an Obligation under an Off-Balance Sheet Arrangement of a Registrant The information set forth in Item 1.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K regarding the Note Purchase Agreement Amendments and the Third Amendment to Credit Agreement is incorporated herein by reference.
